replay.why: The web app inverts with B0 along +z (run_dipole_inversion_wasm is called with 0, 0, 1). QSMxT takes B0 from the affine unless a sidecar sets B0_dir, and the example is 3.6 degrees oblique, so the exported command alone computes a different, affine-aware map (observed.exportedCommand). Remove this once the app passes the affine's B0 direction.

observed.machine: linux-x64, qsmbly bin/qsmbly.js with QSMxT 9.22.0 x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
observed.voxelwise: Replayed against the browser on the voxels both maps hold: correlation 0.995, RMS difference 0.0032 ppm (browser SD 0.032 ppm), concentrated at the brain edge, where the masks differ (Dice 0.998). At least six voxels from the edge: correlation 0.9995, RMS 0.00096 ppm.
